description: This file defines a class 'default_formatter' which provides methods for formatting and rendering connector data in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It includes methods for fetching view formats, managing Smarty templates, and accessing source configurations.

classes.name: default_formatter
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting connector component data within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, including rendering with Smarty templates and managing source configurations.
